items.title: #TombRaider20 custom dog tag
items.description_md: Handed out at the Square Enix Experience at San Diego Comic-Con 2016. The official blog: "After ascending the climbing wall, visitors can secure a custom #TombRaider20 dogtag with their name on." Each tag was stamped with the recipient's own name, so no two are identical.

source.title: Celebrate #TombRaider20 at the San Diego Comic-Con 2016 Square Enix Experience - Official Tomb Raider Blog
source.publisher: Official Tomb Raider Blog (Square Enix / Crystal Dynamics)
source.note: Official Tomb Raider Blog, run by Crystal Dynamics and Square Enix. Post dated 14 July 2016, previewing San Diego Comic-Con 2016. The Square Enix Experience ran Friday 22 and Saturday 23 July 2016 at 7th Avenue and Market Street, San Diego.

verification.note: Opened the publisher's own blog post on 2026-08-18 and read the item descriptions verbatim. The event is nine years past, so these were distributed, not merely announced.

items.title: #TombRaider20 20 Year Celebration lanyard
items.description_md: Lanyard given away across the 2016 Tomb Raider 20 Year Celebration convention circuit. The three official blog posts describe it in slightly different words - San Diego calls it a "#TombRaider20 lanyard, featuring a pixelated tribute to the iconic Lara Croft"; Gamescom and PAX West call it a "20 Year Celebration lanyard" that "features multiple 8-bit Lara's and artifacts". No source states whether these are one lanyard or three, so each show is recorded as its own variant and the question is left open rather than answered by assumption.
